A type occupying l vertices in k runs has m_n(a)=k!/prod(a_j!) * binom(n-l+1,k) placements and isotropy S_{a1} times product_{j>=2}(C2 wr S_{aj}). The restriction zeta transform rho(s)=sum_{A subset dom s}[s restricted A] is multiplicative into the inductive-subgraph isomorphism groupoid algebra and is unitriangular over every unital commutative ring. Groupoid transitive components give K times matrix blocks M_m(K[G_a]), including empty map.
